work.title: Вайбкодинг реальности
work.notes: This pilot manifest publishes provenance for the completed manuscript/edition history. A canonical PDF or EPUB artifact is not yet cryptographically bound in this T-profile record.
work.publication_date_basis: First public UU-AAP provenance declaration for this edition; manuscript completion is separately recorded as 2026-08-08.

actors.name: Matawaka
actors.public_identity_scope: GitHub identity used for the public pilot; legal identity is not asserted by UU-AAP.

actors.name: Усиленный Ум / OpenAI ChatGPT-assisted workflow
actors.identity_note: The work developed across multiple AI-assisted sessions. Exact underlying model/version continuity was not preserved for every session.

responsibility.limitations: The human author set the book's direction, recurring questions and publication intent; AI expanded and challenged candidate formulations.
AI proposed and co-developed alternatives, but inclusion, rejection and continued development of core concepts remained under human selection.
The final architecture of ten parts, twenty-two chapters and an epilogue was approved through iterative human–AI development.
Research and source discovery were AI-assisted in parts of the project; this pilot does not claim a complete public source ledger for every factual statement.
The work is primarily conceptual nonfiction. No independent line-by-line factual audit of the complete manuscript is claimed in this pilot.
The accountable human retained final authority over what remained in the completed manuscript.
This manifest records authorization to expose the work as the first UU-AAP/T pilot. It does not assert store distribution or ISBN registration.
No independent legal review is claimed.
Artifact binding is intentionally deferred because this pilot is profile T rather than V and no canonical PDF/EPUB file is bound yet.

ai_participation.notes: AI participation was material across ideation, comparison of alternatives, structural development, drafting and revision. The manifest deliberately does not translate that participation into a percentage of authorship.

dimensions.summary: The human author initiated the project direction and repeatedly redirected the inquiry through questions, critiques and requested continuations.
Named concepts were introduced, selected and evolved through iterative dialogue; the pilot distinguishes known origins from co-development and uncertainty.
The manuscript converged on ten parts, twenty-two chapters and an epilogue.
AI produced candidate prose and expansions that were iteratively retained, rejected, reframed or extended by the human author.
Some research and checking were AI/tool assisted; no complete independent factual audit is asserted.

concepts.label: Вайбкодинг реальности
concepts.decision_note: The human author established the project concept/title; its operational meaning was then developed through repeated human–AI iteration.

concepts.label: Усиленный Ум
concepts.decision_note: Used by the author as the framing term for AI as cognitive augmentation rather than autonomous replacement.

concepts.label: Принцип неаннигиляции
concepts.decision_note: The principle was developed as a constraint against destroying functions or systems that can instead be transformed, and became Part VIII of the manuscript.

concepts.label: Политика обратимых версий реальности
concepts.decision_note: The book develops reversibility, staged experimentation and explicit commit points as an alternative to one-shot utopian redesign.

concepts.label: Мир, который может передумать
concepts.decision_note: The epilogue consolidates the book's thesis that mature systems must be able to revise models without erasing causal memory.

decision_trace.summary: The manuscript was consolidated into Parts I–X, Chapters 1–22 and an epilogue rather than preserving earlier, more fragmented outlines.

The final chapters explicitly reject treating natural-language intent as sufficient authority to rewrite social reality and instead require feedback, reversibility, scoped responsibility and preserved disagreement.
AI was treated as an amplifier for search, comparison, drafting and critique while the human author retained governing authority over the work's direction and final selection.

The first public provenance record intentionally uses profile T. It exposes process and responsibility without pretending to provide cryptographic artifact binding before a canonical ebook file is selected.

evidence_catalog.description: Master manuscript, chapters 14–22 and epilogue, dated 2026-08-08.
Iterative human–AI project conversations and revision history.

verification.notes: This T-profile pilot verifies disclosure structure and process traceability, not the truth of every claim in the book and not the byte identity of a final ebook artifact.

privacy.notes: Private conversations and complete prompt histories are not published by default. Evidence may be selectively disclosed where needed for a concrete review or dispute.

contestability.notes: The public discussion and Issues provide a challenge channel. A formal independent book-specific appeal body has not yet been established.
